name: 60143 · Itasca, IL
findings: ZIP 60143 (Itasca) has 63 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60143 (Itasca) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
